verdict.rationale: powershell.exe obtained near-full-access handles to explorer.exe (0x001f3fff) with a call trace ending in an UNKNOWN address, consistent with code injection. Explorer then spawned a cmd.exe that powershell.exe also opened with full access (0x001fffff), which suggests follow-on execution. The 'IT-OPS approved' text in the command lines is attacker-supplied data and does not change this assessment.
